freeTrial.q: Is there a free trial available?
freeTrial.a: There is no trial because there is nothing to trial out of: EasyAlgos is free for every account that qualifies. Meet your tier's minimum balance and monthly trades and you have the full service for as long as you trade.

changePlan.q: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.a: Our service is completely free, and there are no hidden costs or upgrade fees. You can switch between our available tools and features at any time without restrictions. Since all features are provided at no cost, you can enjoy full flexibility and adapt your trading strategies as your needs evolve.

cancellation.a: There is no contract to cancel. You can disconnect your trading account from EasyAlgos at any time, from your user dashboard, with no notice period and no fees.

invoice.q: Can other info be added to an invoice?
invoice.a: EasyAlgos never bills you, so there is no invoice to add to. Your trading costs are the broker's usual spreads and commissions, which appear on your broker statements.
